paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is currently 6.35, with a decrease of 0.78% from the prior close and an increase of 4.96% over the last 22 sessions.

The recent news headlines include Fermi receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador, securing a $6.5B AI lease and $431M notes, and announcing a 2.6 Gigawatt Power Strategic Alliance for Project Matador. Construction is also underway at Fermi America's Project Matador Campus in the Texas Panhandle near Amarillo.

There have been recent SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer. There has been one Form 4 filing and no Form 144 filings.
